prompts.dark:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production-ready square hand-painted diffuse texture atlas / trim sheet for dark fantasy game buildings.
Create ONE square 2048x2048 image containing EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square texture tiles. The 16 tiles fill the canvas edge to edge. Every tile occupies exactly one quarter of width and height. Absolutely no gutters, grid outlines, frame, labels, numbers, letters, captions, objects in perspective, mockup, or scene. Orthographic flat surface textures only. Strong hand-painted fantasy RTS quality: broad deliberate brushwork, restrained bright edge strokes, large readable shapes, clean painterly shading, moderate detail, no photoreal noise. The sheet will be UV mapped onto low-poly geometric buildings. Keep detail far enough inside each tile that an inset UV margin is safe.
DARK fortress palette: charcoal violet stone, black iron, oxblood crimson roof and cloth, warm burnt wood, restrained orange ember accents. Not excessively black; midtone surfaces should remain readable.
Exact tiles, ordered left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
Row 1:
1. Charcoal purple ashlar masonry, 3 staggered courses, about 3 broad rectangular blocks per course, narrow dark mortar, subtly hand-painted worn edges.
2. Plain charcoal violet dressed stone with soft painted variation and a few shallow chips, NO brick grid.
3. Dark iron-gray architectural bevel trim: broad flat central field, slim lighter edge strips near left and right, vertical orientation.
4. Broad charcoal stone paving slabs viewed flat, dark fine seams.
Row 2:
5. Deep crimson red roof shingles, 4 overlapping horizontal courses, broad rectangular tiles, soft painterly highlights at lower edges.
6. Very dark warm timber beam surface, subtle vertical grain, no horizontal seams.
7. Black iron flat metal with violet midtones and restrained silver worn edge strokes, no rivets, no object silhouette.
8. Closed dark wooden door texture front-on, vertical boards, two black iron horizontal braces, centered small simple iron ring, full tile filled by door.
Row 3:
9. Deep red cloth surface, very gentle vertical painted folds, no insignia.
10. Deep red cloth with ONE centered small black angular horned emblem occupying central 40 percent, unobstructed margin, no text.
11. Orange-red emissive ember gradient surface with bright amber center and red edges, smooth painted surface, no floating particles.
12. Ruby red crystalline surface, broad angular translucent-looking color planes, no separate gemstone or surrounding background.
Row 4:
13. Gnarled dead-tree bark surface, warm dark red-brown, vertical irregular broad grooves and brush strokes.
14. Cracked charcoal foundation stone surface with only a few broad hairline fractures.
15. Blackened iron reinforcement surface with simple sparse small rivets near corners and broad uncluttered center.
16. Plain very dark warm violet shadow/recess surface, subtle painted variation.
This is a texture asset to use directly on mesh faces; all tiles perfectly square, axis-aligned, no perspective, no text.
